resources.string: Counts reels and shorts. Reads nothing else.

ScrollCount uses this permission for one purpose only: to notice when a new Reel or Short appears on your screen so it can add 1 to your daily count.\n\nIt never reads, stores or sends messages, captions, usernames, comments or video content. It only works inside Instagram and YouTube. Everything it counts stays on this phone - the app has no internet access at all.
Tells you when you reach half of, or all of, your daily reel limit.
An evening recap of how much you scrolled today.
